name: Newgen Software Technologies Ltd
title: Newgen Software Technologies Ltd - 540900 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue grew 6% to INR1,574 cr with adjusted PAT up 6%, but management declined to guide FY27 and flagged slower large-deal closures in India, Middle East and EMEA, plus a rising receivables problem.

triggers.label: India license revenue down 20-30%
triggers.quote: in India we have more like more than 20%, 30% fall in the license revenue

triggers.label: Receivables up on EMEA collections
triggers.quote: our ability to collect in EMEA over the last 1-month has drastically affected the EMEA trade receivables

triggers.label: No FY27 growth number given
triggers.quote: projecting a number for next year may not be advisable

triggers.label: Order book up ~13% YoY
triggers.quote: our overall order book at the end of the year compared to last year has grown by around 13%

guidance.quote: projecting a number for next year may not be advisable

red_flags.label: Receivables rising, EMEA collections slow
red_flags.quote: The collection from the region have also been slower on that account, which has in turn affected the overall DSO.

red_flags.label: Management declines FY27 guidance
red_flags.quote: I think we'll just wait for 1 or 2 quarters till we are getting a much more, better insight

red_flags.label: Large-deal license decline in India
red_flags.quote: we had a very strong pipeline built over 2 years on account of large public sector deals
